remaining_blockers: Pre-existing WARN per strategy tick from cmd/lpbot/position_mark.go:220 (chain type mismatch). The audit's P0-PG-02-C tracks this; not blocking PASS, not caused by this stage.

The shadow binary's RPC layer always falls back to hardcoded public RPC endpoints when chains.base.rpc_primary is empty. The smoke config intentionally leaves rpc_primary empty, but the binary still does startup + periodic public RPC health probes. These are public, free, read-only; no signing, no broadcasting, no paid RPC. A future task could add a 'no-RPC smoke' mode that disables the default endpoints entirely.

The smoke's safety check is a static string-grep on the captured log. A future hardening could also verify the binary's build tag (i.e. confirm the smoke binary was indeed built with -tags=shadow, not the default mode or a different tag).
